web._note: The editor as a DSX package (/web/13 + /web/18): <EditorCanvas> is the module-provided web-facet component (web/index.js mounts the StackCanvas SDK — an editor-grade widget is exactly why facets exist), StackEditor.dsx is the portable component wrapping it, and web.expose compiles that component to the REAL custom element <despia-editor> served from /embed/editor/StackEditor.js (+ .<hash>.js pin). budgetKB is the explicit tool-grade embed budget override (/web/13): the default 40KB widget budget stays law — a package that needs more must say so here, and the build prints the override loudly. origins ['*'] because the editor exists to be embedded anywhere. No native facet on purpose: the editor is the design surface FOR decks, not a deck capability — it badges web-only and degrades honestly on native (Article 7).
